results.content:
Considering 274 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Customers frequently praise the beautiful craftsmanship, unique designs, and overall high quality of the solid wood furniture pieces. Many people also highlight the straightforward ordering process alongside the responsive and helpful communication from the support team. However, some people mentioned sign ificant delivery delays and long wait times for their custom orders to arrive. A few other people also felt that the delivery service fell short due to unhelpful couriers, damaged packaging, or unfulfilled room placement requests. Some reviewers were not happy with communication difficulties and slow responses when trying to resolve these specific problems.See more
